353 of 15,251 menu targets are excluded from every figure on this page — their handle is no longer the one Stage 3 scrapes (dedupe folded it away and nothing removes the row), so they can never be attempted again. 211 of them carried a failing status and were counted as scrape failures until 2026-09-15, a floor no amount of fixing rungs could lower. The census is asserted by coverage_healthcheck's orphan_targets.

no aggregator menu counts Weedmaps/Leafly listings whose own page says they publish no menu — located stores, not coverage gaps. The verdict is written only when a listing is next attempted on the monthly aggregator sweep (0 3 1 * * on the VPS), so a listing that has gone quiet since its last visit still sits inside never scraped until then; that tile over-counts real gaps by however many have not yet been re-asked.

Health check — 6 error(s), 62 warning(s) across 23 check(s)

The coverage invariants scripts/coverage_healthcheck.py asserts against the live database, run at render time and shown here because a verdict that only reaches a terminal and a logfile is a verdict nobody reads. One row per check, errors first; a check that fires for several subjects (states, handles) folds them under its row — open the detail for the full list. The one check NOT run here is the published page's own freshness — its subject is this page, so it can only be answered downstream of the publish, in the nightly cron.

What is breaking now?

Fresh pressure, where acting early is worth the most.

Going dark — anti-bot pressure by platform

The proactive "next NSLC" alarm. Blocked = targets stopped by egress / a challenge; newly failed = flipped to failing in the last 26 h. A rung with blocks that are still arriving (going dark) is actively walling us off — caught here before its snapshots go stale and a state silently zeroes.
